title: No bounded-error ambient convex restriction on a positive balanced complete three-affine-line arrangement
status: FULL5-unit new ROOT working proof, UNREVIEWED

units.statement: A genuine finite rational positive balanced COMPLETE affine-line arrangement and actual positive-growth reference.
units.proof:
Work in ambient rational R^2 with coordinates(x,y). Let L0={(x,0)}, L1={(t,t)}, and L2={(1-s,s)}. Their distinct pairwise intersections are z01=(0,0), z02=(1,0), z12=(1/2,1/2). They are COMPLETE rational affine lines with saturated primitive tangent vectors e0=(1,0), e1=(1,1), e2=(-1,1). Give each line weight1, or any arbitrary positive real weight constant along that line. A finite rational carrier cuts all three pairwise intersections and the function breakpoints below; each resulting interval/ray is a cell, and at a meeting the assigned point is a face of every incident cell. The sum of these line cycles is positive and balanced: each complete line separately has opposite saturated primitive normals of equal weight at every vertex, including meeting vertices. There are no omitted exterior facets or unbalanced boundaries.

Define the ACTUAL reference on the respective lines by
gamma0(x)=max(-x,0,x-1),
gamma1(t)=abs(t),
gamma2(s)=max(-4s,6s-5/2).
All coefficients, constants, breakpoints and spatial carrier are rational; intrinsic tangent slopes are integral. The extra gamma2 breakpoint s=1/4 is rational. Values at z01 are0 on both lines; at z02 are0 on both lines; at z12 are1/2 on both lines. Thus gamma glues continuously. Each branch is convex, finite and PA. On the negative/positive carrying rays its recession slopes are respectively(1,1) onL0, (1,1) onL1, and(4,6) onL2, all strictly positive. Bounded cells have no nonzero recession. Hence the actual reference is positive at infinity on every carrying face. No replacement reference or arbitrary normalization is introduced.

units.statement: Printed PC holds on the actual arrangement, including every incident refined carrier.
units.proof:
At a center not lying at a pairwise meeting, every cell incident to its center face belongs to one line, so ordinary convex Jensen on that line proves every printed PCC. At a meeting, show ONE ambient affine support for BOTH ENTIRE incident branches. At z01 choose p01=(0,1): its slope onL0 is0 in subgradient[-1,0], and onL1 is1 in subgradient[-1,1]. At z02 choose p02=(0,-4): slope onL0 is0 in subgradient[0,1], and onL2 is-4, its actual derivative at s0. At z12 choose p12=(-5/2,7/2): onL1 its slope is1, onL2 its slope is6, the actual derivatives at t=s=1/2. Each covector therefore supports the full incident convex branch functions at the same meeting value. For any legal PCC there, sum the ambient support inequalities; barycenter cancellation gives the Jensen inequality. The nonincident third line does not contain the meeting and cannot supply an incident endpoint cell, so it imposes no printed local constraint there. In particular the supports need not support that nonincident line globally.

The same argument applies to every genuine finite rational common refinement: additional centers either lie in a single convex branch or at one of the same three meetings; inherited incidence and the full incident branch supports persist. All endpoints and centers can be rational as printed; the proof in fact permits real endpoints/weights. Thus gamma is genuine continuous rational-PA PC on the positive balanced complete arrangement, not merely branchwise convex with unchecked meeting gluing.

units.statement: No finite globally convex ambient function has bounded global uniform restriction error.
units.proof:
Let F be ANY finite convex function on ALL ambient R^2; no PA, reference or growth assumption is imposed. Suppose epsilon=sup_{q in L0 union L1 union L2}|F(q)-gamma(q)| is finite. For EVERY integer T>=2 take
a_T=(T,T) inL1,
b_T=(2-2T,0) inL0,
c_T=(a_T+b_T)/2=(1-T/2,T/2) inL2.
These are rational original points. Exact reference values are gamma(a_T)=T, gamma(b_T)=2T-2, and gamma(c_T)=3T-5/2, since s=T/2 puts gamma2 on its positive affine branch. Global ambient convex Jensen gives
3T-5/2-epsilon <= F(c_T) <= (F(a_T)+F(b_T))/2 <= 3T/2-1+epsilon.
Consequently epsilon >= (3/4)(T-1) for EVERY integerT>=2, impossible for any finiteepsilon. Therefore sup_original|F-gamma|=+infinity for EVERY finite globally convex F. The infimum of these extended distances is+infinity: there is not even a bounded-error ambient convex restriction, much less arbitrary uniform approximation by such restrictions. This is an algebraic proof on an unbounded rational family, not a finite-grid extrapolation.

The displayed barycenter comparison is legal for GLOBALambient convexity. It is NOT a legal printed PCC on the arrangement: for T>=2 the center c_T is on the nonmeeting interior ofL2, whereas the two endpoint cells onL0/L1 are nonincident. No invalid coarsening or global Jensen property is assigned to printed-PC gamma. This distinction is exactly why A1 and the global convex obstruction are compatible.

units.statement: Failure of an ambient convex minorant to preserve even a local shared-face value.
units.proof:
The same example also shows why one global ambient convex minorant cannot automatically be exact on all distinct meeting faces. At z12=(1/2,1/2), the incident restrictions have derivatives1 onL1 and6 onL2; their unique ambient covector is p12=(-5/2,7/2), and its touching affine function is ell(x,y)=(-5/2)x+(7/2)y (intercept0). If a finite convex G onALLR^2 satisfies G<=gamma on the ENTIREarrangement and G(z12)=gamma(z12)=1/2, any ambient support of G at z12 has the same two tangent derivatives: from G<=gamma with equality there, directional secants in both signs along either incident line force the support restriction to equal the differentiable gamma derivative. The two independent line directions force the UNIQUEp12, hence ell<=G everywhere. But at(-1,0) inL0, ell=5/2>gamma0(-1)=1, contradicting G<=gamma. Thus no such full ambient convex minorant is exact at z12.

The ordinary support premise can be proved by nearest-point separation of the closed epigraph and unit-normal limit at(z12,G(z12)-delta): full spatial domain makes the limiting vertical coefficient strictly positive. Finite convex G is locally continuous/Lipschitz by cube-vertex upper bounds, reflection lower bounds and bounded secants. These elementary proofs avoid importing any special non-Archimedean theorem.

The common support p12 required for printedPC at z12 supports ONLY the two incident branches. The nonincidentL0 constraint blocks a global support there. Whole common-H joint-dual arguments cannot be transferred by simply adding restrictions from every nonincident page when several different meeting faces occur.
